title: Phase 5 / E08: Sealed Bounded Formal Assurance (TLA+ / Model Checking) Protocol
phase: Phase 5 — Formal Verification & Bounded State Exploration
primary_question: Are the 15 GLHS GRWC formal invariants (I01 through I15) satisfied with zero counterexamples across exhaustive bounded state-space exploration of docs/formal/GLHS_GSA.tla up to search depth d=6?
unit_of_analysis: One state-space exploration trajectory evaluated by the TLC Model Checker.

primary_endpoints.name: Invariant Violation Count
primary_endpoints.definition: Count of reachable model trace states violating any formal invariant I01-I15 within depth d=6.

secondary_endpoints.name: Explored State Space Node Count
secondary_endpoints.definition: Total number of unique reachable state graph nodes explored by TLC.

sample_size.unit_definition: 69,342 unique states explored up to BFS search depth 6

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: A single state violating any invariant I01-I15 produces a counterexample trace and halts execution.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Unexplored depth boundaries cannot be claimed as universally verified.
